basic_info.description: Master of Curb Appeal and Classic Charm.  Step inside this cozy floor plan of 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, living/dining room combo, updated kitchen w/ quartz counters, some windows dual pane, gleaming wood-floors, and low maintenance/well maintained yard for entertaining or just relaxing. Come home from work to enjoy a glass of wine and enjoy a view of the SF Downtown skyline view from your own front porch!  Garage consists of 1 car parking with plenty of storage or room for a home gym, plus driveway room for a 2nd car. Home is detached providing plenty of natural light.  Conveniently located to BART/Muni, shops, restaurants, and commerce. Welcome to your new home!
